Pasta Cosí is a must visit
Jan 2026 • Business
This place was great. It was completely packed at 2pm on a Sunday. The pasta was made right in house; you could see the machine and where they stored each type of it. You basically pick what you want off the menu as well as the type of noodle for it to be served with. I had one called “first date” and it was good. Both the waiter and host spoke English and both checked in on me. My lunch was also served with some crusty bread as well. The pasta was piping hot. I highly recommend Pasta Cosi.

Excellent Italian Restaurant
Aug 2025 • Family
We dined at Pasta Cosi whilst visiting Sidi Bou Said and the Carthage. The establishment was recommended to us by a friend who knew the area well. We were a large group of 2 families and the restaurant managed to accommodate the 9 of us. The pasta is made freshly each day on site. The names of the dishes on menu was very amusing. Definately aimed at the younger generation. The restaurant is situated in an up market area of Tunis. However it lacks in parking. Very busy restaurant. The children in the group fully enjoyed their large pizzas. The pasta dishes were generous portion sizes. My dish "after life" had mozzarella, cherry tomatoes, courgettes, aubergines. Incredible food.

Fresh Pasta Done Right — Family Favorite in Lac 1!
Aug 2025 • Family
Fresh Pasta Done Right — Family Favorite in Lac 1!

We visited Pasta Cosi in Lac 1 as a family and had a fantastic experience. The pasta portions were generous, and the taste truly delivered — fresh, flavorful, and made in-house. You can really tell the difference when pasta is prepared fresh, and Pasta Cosi nails it.

The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the staff made the whole experience even better — friendly, smiling, and attentive throughout.

Whether you're a pasta lover or just looking for a great, casual Italian spot in Tunis, this place is a solid choice. We’ll definitely be coming back!
